pageProps.title: God's Quiz: Reboot (2018)
pageProps.review: God's Quiz: Reboot is a mystery crime drama review that sophisticatedly revived the series' identity with the new concept of AI autopsy, depicting a confrontation and revenge plot between attractive villains.
pageProps.content:
## Review It was sophisticatedly revived without losing the identity of the series. It reflected the changes of the times well by introducing the concept of artificial intelligence into autopsies.
It feels like the protagonist is caught in the crossfire between villains, but you end up rooting for the villain seeking revenge.
